## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* Northern-Sòng repentance liturgy by **Sì-míng Zhīlǐ** 四明知禮 (960–1028) for the *Jīn-guāng-míng zuì-shèng wáng jīng* 金光明最勝王經 ([義淨](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BE%A9%E6%B7%A8) Yìjìng's Tang translation of the *Suvarṇaprabhāsa-sūtra*). The work is parallel to [遵式](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%B5%E5%BC%8F) Zūnshì's *Bǔ-zhù yí* ([KR6d0195](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0195)) and demonstrates Zhīlǐ's substantial contribution to the Sòng Tiāntái liturgical tradition alongside his polemical-doctrinal output.

**Abstract**

The *Zuì-shèng chàn-yí* belongs to Zhīlǐ's broader liturgical productive corpus and represents the *shān-jiā* tradition's contribution to the Sòng *Suvarṇaprabhāsa* devotional liturgy. The composition is bracketed within Zhīlǐ's mature productive period at the Yán-qìng-sì 延慶寺 in Sì-míng, c. 996–1028.
